scope: N693 last-good pipeline JSON snapshot preservation only

baseline.cause: Existing JSON truncates on recursive serialization or interrupted native stream; new target left partial. Old implementation has no atomic replace boundary.

behavior: Existing plain()/JSON byte formatting unchanged; serialize fully before any target mutation
Private sibling folder stages normal-mode file then existing journal atomic writer produces complete bytes; final native replace only after success
Preserves existing mode and normal umask-based new-file mode
Existing symlink remains linked to its updated target
Read-only target still refuses; missing parent still not created
Serialization/partial native stream/replace failures preserve previous bytes or leave absent target absent; private staging cleaned
limitations: CSV output remains separate; no CSV+JSON transaction guarantee
Directory fsync/host power-loss durability not established
Atomic replacement can change inode/hard-link alias behavior and requires writable parent
Concurrent external mutation of destination/symlink is not serialized
No model/network/GPU/inference/full CI or native other-OS acceptance
